units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:3">Ib. X, 3</cite> <he>בפוּנְדָּתוֹ ופיה למטה</he> (if he carries an object) in his belt with its opening downward.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 10:3">Ib.</cite> <he>בין פונדתו לחלוקו</he> between his belt and his undergarment; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 8:14">Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 14</cite> <he>בפי פ׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>בפרפונדא</he>) if he placed the object of trust in the mouth of his money-bag (whence it could easily be taken out or lost) or on the edge of his roof &c.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00261"><he>פּוּנְדָּיוֹת</he></cite>.
